text:
amanda: Anyone seeing GPU nodes stuck in Provisioning in eu-west after the overnight surge?
raj: Yep, ~30 queued. NV pods failing during init with KMS decrypt errors and `504` to kms endpoints.
miguel: I saw NAT GW burst metrics — per-gw concurrent connections spiked and started returning ENOBUFS/timeout.
liz: VPC flow logs sampling looks jumpy around 02:12, got gaps for the keystore IP range; audit uploads to s3 show missing windows.
amanda: deploy-bot posted: "autoscaler: scale-up failed for shard-eu-west-2 - keystore timeout" :grimacing:
raj: Quick dump from node logs:
```
2026-03-19T02:11:45Z keystore: decrypt timeout
2026-03-19T02:12:01Z nvidia-init: device attach OK
2026-03-19T02:12:05Z sidecar: S3 upload 502
```
miguel: Two hypotheses: NAT GW per-second connection limit + aggressive conn reuse causing socket exhaustion, or our keystore endpoint hitting a soft rate limit.
liz: Also noticed IAM role chained calls increase auth latency — cross-account assume-role for keystore proxy adds ~80ms per call.
amanda: Short-term mitigation ideas?
raj: 1) Add a spare NAT GW and move some subnets to it. 2) Enable proxying to keystore via internal LB (reduce public egress). 3) Retry backoff on keystore client.
miguel: Also flip S3 -> VPC endpoint for audit uploads so they don't count against NAT bandwidth.
liz: Ops-bot: filed ticket INFRA-3721 for audit log gap, added retention note.
ops-bot: INFRA-3721 created: "eu-west audit upload gap during NAT burst" assigned to raj.
amanda: Cost callout: adding NAT GW and internal LB increases monthly costs, but we should weigh vs SLA for Dedicated customers.
raj: For autoscaler: we can slow down scale-up concurrency to avoid thundering herd on keystore — change max-parallel-provisions from 8 -> 3.
miguel: I'll prototype a lightweight KMS proxy (cache short-lived plaintext keys) to reduce decrypt calls during bootstrap. Will PR tomorrow.
liz: For long term: consider keystore regional replicas or per-zone cache + signed tokens to reduce cross-account assume-role.
amanda: TLDR: immediate -> add NAT GW, S3 VPC endpoints, reduce parallel provisioning. Mid -> keystore proxy. Track audit gaps ticket.
raj: I'll make the change to autoscaler now and open infra PR for NAT GW switch.
amanda: Thanks — please ping #oncall if any prod regressions. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollback guard enabled for shard-eu-west-2 until INFRA-3721 resolved.
sre-bot: monitoring alert created: keystore_decrypt_time_p95 > 500ms for 5m.
